# dsh-redact
Redacts secrets from tool output before it reaches the model or the session log.

An agent's transcript is written to disk and sent to a model provider on every turn.
That transcript

quietly fills up with credentials: `env` output, a `cat .env`, a
`git remote -v` with a token in th

e URL, a connection string in a stack trace. This
plugin rewrites that copy in place, so the transcr

ipt is safe to keep and share while
the tools themselves keep full access.
**Design principle: redact the transcript, never the process.**
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Nothing is blocked, no command is rewritten, and no permission is reduced. Only the
text destined fo
r the model and the saved session is altered.
## What it catches
Four tiers, each independently switchable.
| Tier | Default | Catches |
| `exact` | on | Values of sensitive-looking environment variables (`DATABASE_URL`, `MYSQL_PWD`, pro

xy URLs, …) plus any `secrets` you configure |
| `patterns` | on | Known credential formats (below),

PEM private keys, JWTs, `Bearer …` headers, and URL userinfo passwords |
| `context` | on | Prefix-

less credentials recognised only beside their documented name (AWS secret/session tokens) |
| `keywo
rds` | off | `password=`, `token=`, `api_key=` anchored values. Opt-in: higher false-positive risk |
### Recognised credential formats

Rules are generated from a declared prefix, body character class, and the length
vendors actually is
sue, so the matcher cannot drift away from this table.
| Format | Prefix | Body length |

| `aws-access-key` | `AKIA` / `ASIA` | 16 |
| `github-token` | `gh[pousr]_` | 36 |
| `github-pat` |

`github_pat_` + 22 + `_` | 59 |
| `gitlab-pat` | `glpat-` | 20 |
| `openai-key` | `sk-` | 48 |
| `op

enai-project-key` | `sk-proj-` | ≥ 40 |
| `anthropic-key` | `sk-ant-` | ≥ 20 |
| `google-api-key` |

`AIza` | 35 |
| `stripe-secret` | `sk_live_` / `rk_live_` | 24 |
| `twilio-key` | `SK` | 32 hex |
|

`sendgrid-key` | `SG.` + 22 + `.` | 43 |
| `npm-token` | `npm_` | 36 |
| `digitalocean-token` | `dop

_v1_` | 64 hex |
| `shopify-token` | `shpat_` | 32 hex |
| `mailgun-key` | `key-` | 32 hex |
| `slac
k-token` | `xox[baprs]-` | ≥ 10 |

Matching deliberately omits a trailing word boundary: a credential pasted with text
glued to it stil

l loses its credential portion. A lookalike that is too short is left
alone. Unknown formats are out

of scope by design — the `exact` tier is what covers
secrets without a recognisable shape.

Path-like values (`PWD`, `OLDPWD`, `KUBECONFIG`) are never redacted unless the
variable name strongl

y indicates a credential (`MYSQL_PWD` is a password; `PWD` is
not), so ordinary output stays readabl

indicates a credential (`MYSQL_PWD` is a password; `PWD` is
not), so ordinary output stays readable.
## What it does not do
Worth knowing before you rely on it:

- **It redacts, it does not revoke.** If a secret already reached a provider, this
plugin does not u

n-send it.
- **Only tool output is covered.** Model-authored text, prompts, your shell history,
and

the application's own log files are outside the hook.
- **The `exact` tier is snapshotted at startup

** from the environment the plugin loads
in. A variable exported later is not picked up until restar

t.
- **Values shorter than `minLength`** (default 8) are ignored, to avoid redacting
ordinary words.

- **It cannot recognise what it has no rule for.** Base64-wrapped, split, or
re-encoded secrets pas

s through. Coverage is a net, not a guarantee.
- **No network access and no process mutation.** It r

eads text and returns text; the
only write is an optional diagnostic line to `debugFile`.
## Install

Requires a DeepSeek Harness install
with the plugin manager. The package has **zero runtime dependen

cies**, so it does not
need the Harness package graph to import.
### From GitHub (recommended)
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The plugin manager verifies the repository, installs it, and selects it into the
profile's bundle li

st. Host plugins load at boot, so **restart the app** afterwards.
The plugin then appears in **Setti
ngs → Plugins**, enabled by default.
To remove it:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
### From a local checkout
Add the dependency to the profile's `package.json`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then run `pnpm install` in the profile directory and restart.

The shipped `cordis.patch.yml` names its entry relatively (`./lib/index.js`) on
purpose. A `link:` i

nstall's real directory sits outside `node_modules`, where a bare
package name resolves through a de

pendency mapping that does not exist there; a
relative name resolves beside the patch in every insta

ll shape. This is safe here
only because the plugin imports nothing from the Harness — a plugin that

imports
Harness packages must be named bare instead.
## Configure

Override the bundle's row by id in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. Use an override,
not a second `
insert` — inserting again would declare the row twice.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Field | Default | Meaning |

| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch; `false` returns every result untouched |
| `tiers.exact` | `tr

ue` | Redact known secret values from the environment and `secrets` |
| `tiers.patterns` | `true` |

Redact known formats and structural shapes |
| `tiers.context` | `true` | Redact name-anchored crede

ntials |
| `tiers.keywords` | `false` | Redact keyword-anchored values (noisy) |
| `minLength` | `8`

| Shortest value considered a secret |
| `allowNames` | `["SSH_AUTH_SOCK"]` | Variable names to ski

p even when their value looks sensitive |
| `secrets` | `[]` | Extra literal values to redact, for a
nything the environment does not expose |

A secret present in both the environment and `secrets` is redacted once, labelled with
the environme

nt variable's name. Values are matched longest-first, so a longer secret
is replaced before a shorte
r one that is a substring of it.
## Verify it works

Three levels, cheapest first. The first is automatic; the other two cover what it
cannot reach.

**1. Boot probe — automatic.** Every start writes a line to `~/.dsh/health.log` (see
Startup self-ch
eck). `ok` means the matcher still redacts.

**2. Hook probe — one tool call.** The boot probe exercises the matcher, not the hook.
